purpose: Provisional skeleton-first neutral standing spinopelvic reference family P1. Provides a coherent male global target and a source-derived lumbar distribution without yet claiming final 3D endplate coordinates.

lumbar_distribution.rationale: The 2022 asymptomatic cohort PI mean (50.5°) closely matches the male Hasegawa PI mean (50.1°). Its level distribution is therefore used as a shape template and scaled to the Hasegawa male L1-S1 mean of 56.4°.
lumbar_distribution.guard: These are reference-pose segmental targets, not ROM limits. They must remain within source SD corridors and may be adjusted when the final S1/endplate geometry is solved.

measurement_semantics.includes: upper vertebral body wedging plus intervening disc
measurement_semantics.verified_definition: Figure 5C of DOI 10.1038/s41598-022-21840-x depicts adjacent superior endplate lines; Fig 5B and methods define L1/L4/S1 superior endplate reference chain.
measurement_semantics.author_note: Legacy KIM_2022 identifier retained for compatibility; DOI/title identify the source. Original PDF first author Fei-Li Fang; do not infer Kim authorship from the identifier.

evidence: Hasegawa male C2-C7 global mean is near neutral (source convention +lordosis: -0.6 ±8.6°).
Reinhold/DGOU segmental means sum to 9.6° lordosis under their opposite sign convention.
cervical_policy.rule: Do not average signed cervical values. Choose the final cervical neutral family after C7/T1 and head-over-pelvis constraints are assembled.

thoracic_policy.rule: Do not distribute 43.7° uniformly. Per-level curvature must respect thoracic body/endplate geometry and rib attachment levels.

acceptance_before_coordinate_freeze: S1 superior endplate frame and sacral slope instantiated consistently.
Scaled lumbar segment angles remain within source-specific normal corridors.
T12/L1 endplate angles pass Crawford cross-check after frame mapping.
Thoracic per-level curve sums to selected T1-T12 target within tolerance and keeps rib-level attachments coherent.
Cervical reference family is explicitly selected and head-over-pelvis/global SVA is checked.
No intervertebral disc-bearing level collapses to zero gap.
